name: properties
title: Properties
description: Domain-neutral property patterns for React applications.
author: Gabriel Melo

files.content:
export * from './date'
export * from './person'
export * from './select'
export * from './string'
export {
  PROPERTY_PRIMITIVE_TYPES,
  type PropertyDefinition,
  type PropertyPrimitiveType,
  type PropertyValueChange,
} from './types'

export {
  DateProperty,
  type DatePropertyActionContext,
  DatePropertyButton,
  type DatePropertyDropdownPlacement,
  type DatePropertyProps,
  formatDateProperty,
  parseDatePropertyValue,
  serializeDatePropertyValue,
} from './date-property'

export {
  PersonProperty,
  type PersonPropertyActionContext,
  PersonPropertyButton,
  type PersonPropertyAvatar,
  type PersonPropertyDropdownPlacement,
  type PersonPropertyOption,
  type PersonPropertyProps,
} from './person-property'
export {
  MultiPersonProperty,
  type MultiPersonPropertyActionContext,
  MultiPersonPropertyButton,
  type MultiPersonPropertyProps,
} from './multi-person-property'

export {
  SelectProperty,
  type SelectPropertyActionContext,
  SelectPropertyButton,
  type SelectPropertyDropdownPlacement,
  type SelectPropertyIcon,
  type SelectPropertyOption,
  type SelectPropertyProps,
} from './select-property'

docs: Install the npm package first, then add this local registry item with the shadcn CLI. The registry targets @components/patterns/properties and declares the required COSS primitives as registryDependencies, so components.json can keep aliases.ui mapped to @/components/ui.
